observations: Measured test-step elapsed seconds from GitHub job timestamps are shard1 3994, shard2 4634, shard3 1679, shard4 3236. TAP totals retain higher precision in shards[].summary.
The four shard inventories are 226,225,225,225 files but observed shard runtime is imbalanced. No measured speedup or predicted production saving is claimed.

Top-level case-duration sums exceed shard wall time: 11443424.277209ms,12181240.676287001ms,4580412.892946ms,7694410.593488ms. They must not be mislabeled as serial execution costs or summed blindly as full-file durations.

whole-originals-host-v3-solo.test.mjs and v4-solo.test.mjs both invoke qualifySolo in whole-originals-host-scenarios.mjs, replaying71 mission clears per version; analogous v3/v4 Versus tests invoke qualifyVersus. This repeats expensive scenario machinery for intentionally different historical route bindings. Do not deduplicate coverage without semantic review.

scripts/test-external-distribution.mjs:74 builds the real source and validates generated external bytes, while the independent build job also runs npm run build. Its measured case is391741.731228ms. This is repeated class-of-work, not proof of redundant assertions. The test already combines six historical cohorts using the same authenticated build bytes.

preflight Verify immutable production sources first runs scripts/test-production-*.mjs, and these matching files also belong to the full901-file shard inventory. The duplicate execution is intentional early gating; changes require explicit qualification design review.

Checkout/install/identity overhead is measurable separately: complete-history build checkout277s; shard source checkouts43/66/27/229s; dependency installs2s each. No I/O phase has been profiled further.

Recommended next measurement: a Node20-compatible reporter or process-level harness that captures genuine file execution boundaries with exact source/inventory/node/runner/concurrency identity while retaining all normal tests, TAP and failure exits. Null durations remain unknown; do not populate weights with case sums or buffered log gaps.
limitations: One successful candidate sample only; runner contention and cache variation were not controlled.
Top40Cases retains top-level cases, not all nested cases. It is descriptive case evidence, not a file duration dataset.
Literal source matches can be absent for dynamically generated case names; absent matches were not guessed.

No builds, tests, workflow runs, branch changes, cancellations, commits or remote writes were performed by this audit. Only this JSON and a bounded raw ZIP in task-owned temporary storage were written.
